# Mangling conformance vectors -- shared by the Rust and C# implementations.
#
# Tab separated:  source <TAB> mangled <TAB> display
#   mangled = the catalog key (what lands in msgid)
#   display = unmangled with the markers dropped, i.e. what a player sees
# Unmangling back to source is asserted too.
#
# These values were captured from the original implementation in the Old Gods
# codebase and must not be edited to match a code change: they are baked into
# every msgid in every existing catalog. See rust/putki-inki/src/inki/loc.rs.
plain text with no markers	plain text with no markers	plain text with no markers
Deal 20% extra damage	Deal {12}% extra damage	Deal 20% extra damage
Deal 20% then heal 30% more	Deal {12}% then heal {34}% more	Deal 20% then heal 30% more
Hello {#Bob}!	Hello {12}!	Hello Bob!
Hello {player}	Hello {player}	Hello {player}
{#Ada} deals 20% to {player}	{12} deals {34}% to {player}	Ada deals 20% to {player}
007% of nothing	{12}% of nothing	007% of nothing
abc% stays	abc% stays	abc% stays
100%	{12}%	100%
Skada 20% åäö	Skada {12}% åäö	Skada 20% åäö
# A literal {12} in authored text collides with the placeholder table. The
# original implementation threw ArgumentOutOfRangeException here; both putki
# implementations leave the span untouched instead.
{12} torch(es) found	{12} torch(es) found	{12} torch(es) found
